title: Peck
blurb: A peck is an imperial and United States customary unit of dry volume, equivalent to 8 dry quarts or 16 dry pints. An imperial peck is equivalent to 9.09218 liters and a US customary peck is equivalent to 8.80976754172 liters.
facts: Although the peck is no longer widely used, some produce, such as apples, are still often sold by the peck in the U.S..
